titre: Complémentaire santé solidaire (C2S): free or low-cost top-up health cover
resume: Free or low-cost top-up health coverage for the whole household, children included, based on your income over the last 12 months, with higher income limits in Réunion than in mainland France.
aQuoiCaSert: The Complémentaire santé solidaire (C2S) pays the share of your health expenses that the Assurance Maladie (French public health insurance) does not reimburse, up to the Sécurité sociale (social security) rates. Depending on your resources, it is free or costs a small contribution each month. It covers everyone in the household, so your children too. It is often the right solution when you have a low income and no mutuelle (top-up health insurance).
quiEstConcerne: Low-income households who have lived in France on a stable and lawful basis for more than 3 months.
People receiving the RSA (revenu de solidarité active, the minimum income benefit): free C2S is granted to them automatically, unless they object.
Single parents and families with no top-up health cover for their children.
aSavoir: With the C2S: no extra fees above the standard rates (dépassements d'honoraires), no upfront payment (tiers payant, third-party payment) and the daily hospital charge (forfait hospitalier) is covered.
Annual income limits in Réunion (as in Guadeloupe, French Guiana and Martinique) for free C2S: €11,599 for 1 person, €17,398 for 2, €20,878 for 3, €24,358 for 4, then €4,640 per additional person.
C2S with a contribution in Réunion: resources up to €15,659 for 1 person, €23,488 for 2, €28,185 for 3, €32,883 for 4, then €6,263 per additional person.

The resources counted are those of the 12 months before the application. A flat-rate housing amount (forfait logement) is added if you receive housing benefit, are housed free of charge or own your home.
The decision is made within 2 months; without a reply within this time, the application is accepted. If refused, an amicable appeal is possible within 2 months.
The C2S is granted for 1 year. Renewal must be requested between 4 and 2 months before the end date, unless it is automatic (RSA, Aspa, Asi, and AAH with no change of situation).

Separated parents: the C2S covers the household that applies for it. A child in shared residence is in principle counted in only one parent's household: ask the CGSS (Caisse générale de sécurité sociale, the local social security fund).

documents.libelle: Cerfa n° 12504 form, completed and signed, if you are not applying online
documents.detail: It lists the household members and their resources over the last 12 months.

documents.libelle: Tax notice (avis d'impôt) or tax return statement (avis de situation déclarative)
Property tax notice (taxe foncière), if you own your home
Proof of resources for the last 12 months, if requested
documents.detail: Payslips, allowances, child support received. The fund may ask for other documents.

documents.libelle: Statement of resources from the Caf, if an RSA application is under way
documents.detail: Downloadable from your Caf (Caisse d'allocations familiales, the family benefits office) account.

documents.libelle: Tax and social security documents from each country, if you lived abroad in the last 12 months

documents.detail: It shows the end date of your entitlement: note it for the renewal.

etapes.detail: Add up the household's resources over 12 months and compare them with the Réunion limits. Have your tax notice and supporting documents ready.
From your ameli account: this is the fastest way. You can also send the Cerfa n° 12504 form to the CGSS de La Réunion.

If you submit the file at a front desk: signed form, tax notice, property tax notice, Caf certificate if an RSA application is under way, proof of resources, ID and carte Vitale (health insurance card). Keep copies.
It arrives within 2 months. If refused, refer the matter to the amicable appeals board (commission de recours amiable) within 2 months.
Between 4 and 2 months before the end date shown on your certificate.

ou.detail: Apply online from your ameli account, or by mail. Phone: 36 46.
Free help with online procedures near you.

datesLimites.detail: To the fund's amicable appeals board.
